<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Institutional divergence:</strong> Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) have provided a buffer to the markets by pouring ₹23,160 crore into stocks, effectively countering the ₹5,610 crore sold by Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) over the last three sessions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxQbzNGMld1MlN1SkNRbTA2cnNTWkh6UDZNdWplM3BGRDdWeXZlV3ExeWdZbkxoLUt3WjhjQ1dKYk9JX0VwYi1QVWR4UkJGSUhzOEtrVkk4YjZsOHB1LTl1U2owTkFNY3RJTklucEZxZmE5WkJuTFYwQXNaVnVVNno0LVpiQUEyNUt3ejR5dndwUDhONEN1a3Znd25hRGh0M3dZOGhUYm9FV3ptQUFiUFhUbGUtSUpFY1BSM3BvODZPXzJiLURvUG03TFFn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>
